claims: The authored native probe ran 16 cases (10 original fixed-LOD/redirect cases and 6 new LCM=0,L=0,K=0 Q-based cases) and exited 0 with empty stderr.
In all six new Q-based cases, with Q equal to 1, 0.5 and 0.25 in both UV and ST modes, the public CPU backend output equals the level-0 TEX0 base plane color 0x800000ff.

Four of the six Q-based cases (Q=0.5 and Q=0.25 in each of UV and ST modes) disagree with the level 1 and level 2 plane colors predicted by the manual Q-based LOD formula, giving 8 manual disagreements across all 16 cases.
The public SampleTexture implementation takes no LOD input: it reads context.tex0.tbp0/tbw and base dimensions; the sprite draw path calls it with q=1.0 and never reads tex1 or miptbp1.
These results show a gap in the public CPU backend relative to the manual, and do not show original game corruption, hardware behavior, or what Ford Racing 2 draws sample.
